newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Aristocrat says Colorado licence denied.
newsitem.headline: Aristocrat says Colorado licence denied.

text.p: Gaming machine group Aristocrat Leisure Ltd said on Friday it had received a "notice of denial" for the renewal of a manufacturing and distributors licence from the Colorado Gaming Control Commission in the United States.

The company said it would continue to hold the licence pending an August 28 hearing on the notice. Aristocrat Inc president and chief executive officer Dean McClain said he was surprised that the notice had been issued.
The statement was issued after the close of share market trading. Aristocrat shares ended three cents higher at A$3.03.
"We have already taken substantial actions which we believe address concerns raised by the Commission," McClain said.
"The company will immediately work with the Commission and the Colorado Division of Gaming to explain the effect of these actions and, where appropriate, present new evidence," he said.
The company did not outline the Commission's concerns.
Aristocrat executive chairman John Dougall said the company would also seek to allay concerns in other jurisdictions.
